firmware_format: ELF32 little-endian RV32IMC ET_EXEC, RAM-only PT_LOAD
boot: direct ELF entry, no boot ROM, flash image or persistent eFuse file
completion: exact UART assertions and unforced native exit zero
virtual_clock: icount shift=0, align=off, sleep=on; elapsed time not measured
mmio_diagnostics: fail emitted guest_errors/unimp/warnings; silent upstream stubs are not detectable
